dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I was wondering if you could help me with my contract.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf juː kʊd ˈhɛlp miː wɪð maɪ ˈkɑːntrækt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. What would you like to know?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈnoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It ends next month, and I'm not sure whether to renew it.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɛndz ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ, ənd aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr ˈwɛðər tə rɪˈnuː ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. Is there a problem with your service?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ɪz ðɛr ə ˈprɑːbləm wɪð jʊr ˈsɜːrvɪs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, after last week, I'm thinking about switching to another provider.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ˈæftər ˈlæst ˈwiːk, aɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈswɪtʃɪŋ tə əˈnʌðər prəˈvaɪdər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I was wondering if I could offer you a better deal.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri tə ˈhɪr ˈðæt. aɪ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf aɪ kʊd ˈɔːfər juː ə ˈbɛtər ˈdiːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. My monthly fee is 900 baht, and other providers are cheaper.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. maɪ ˈmʌnθli ˈfiː ɪz ˈnaɪn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt, ənd ˈʌðər prəˈvaɪdərz ər ˈtʃiːpər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: If you renew today, we can reduce your monthly fee to 700 baht.
dialogue.reading: ɪf juː rɪˈnuː təˈdeɪ, wiː kən rɪˈduːs jʊr ˈmʌnθli ˈfiː tə ˈsɛvən ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's better. I was wondering if you could improve my data plan, too.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈbɛtər. aɪ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf juː kʊd ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈdeɪtə ˌplæn, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can double the data on your phone at no extra cost.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ kən ˈdʌbəl ðə ˈdeɪtə ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn ət ˈnoʊ ˈɛkstrə ˈkɔːst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I'll renew. I was wondering if you could send me the details by email.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl rɪˈnuː. aɪ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf juː kʊd ˈsɛnd miː ðə ˈdiːteɪlz baɪ ˈiːmeɪl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. You'll receive them in a few minutes.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. juːl rɪˈsiːv ðɛm ɪn ə ˈfjuː ˈmɪnɪts.
